from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquityData(BaseModel):
    """The '归属于母公司股东权益' reported for one company in their financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as named in the document")
    equity_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric equity value")
    equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit: '元', '百万元', '百万元人民币', etc.")
    equity_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact field label as written (e.g., '归属于上市公司股东的所有者权益', '归属于母公司所有者权益合计')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period/date the figure represents")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the equity value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_equity_data: list[CompanyEquityData]
